protocol.scope: Cross-instrument transfer with actual declared Original Dreadnought/Spruce and Bellido Auditorium/Mahogany presets; not matching either source guitar exactly
protocol.attack: Own1ms RMS-energy follower crossing0.0025 of first250ms peak, then0–15ms periodic Hann window with4x zero padding;2–12kHz power divided by80–12kHz total; paired median model-minus-target, not difference of medians
protocol.harmonic_balance: Own2%-of-whole-record-peak sample onset;80–250ms symmetric Hann,4x zero padding;mean peak dB H5–H12 minus mean peak dB H1–H4,35cent search; paired median; no explicit interharmonic-noise floor in this diagnostic
protocol.decay: AuditDampingCurve own2%-peak onset;STFT8192 Hann,7/8 overlap and4096 check;H1–H40 <=9kHz;0.15–1.2sec,12x interharmonic-power-floor and within45dB ownpeak,>=10frames;decaying slope>1dB/s;306/602/668Hz+-50cent artefact mask;admit only when each side agrees within3dB/s across windows;then pair exact nominal partial frequencies
limitations: Monophonic captures; microphone/room and unknown source fingering can affect apparent shape and decay.
Martin technique unknown and remains Finger primary by prior policy; no style selected by score.
Nominal-partial peak slope can mix polarization doublets; it is not an identified intrinsic string-loss coefficient.
Harmonic balance lacks independent noise-floor admission and can be affected by notches/weak partials; cannot by itself authorize a parameter.
Admission can change with width; report coverage and all rows.
All files measured in mono average; native stereo capture is preserved on disk; gain cancels from shape but dynamics stays scored separately.
